source.citation: 'The Great fire at Chicago. Scene in Wells Street - the terrified populace in front of the Briggs House.' Wood engraving, Frank Leslie's Illustrated Newspaper, 28 October 1871. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, LC-USZ62-109590 (item 94501371).
what_it_does_not_supply: a photograph's exactness; any named person; colour
what_it_supplies: what an engraver of 1871 drew Chicago's street crowd wearing: felt hats, sack coats, beards and side whiskers; women's long skirts, shawls and small hats
